died.name: 75 people on board Aeroflot Flight 593
died.cause: Relief captain Yaroslav Kudrinsky brought his two teenaged children to the cockpit of an Airbus A310 during an international passenger flight and allowed them to sit at the controls. His 15-year-old son unknowingly disengaged the autopilot; the aircraft was sent into a nosedive and crashed, with all occupants killed on impact.

born.last_words: The water's dark green and I can't see a bloody thing. Hallo the bow is up. I'm going. I'm on my back. I'm gone.
